component.name: Godot RE Tools
component.summary: Recover Godot projects, extract PCK archives and decompile GDScript

description.p: Godot RE Tools recovers a Godot project from a game's PCK archive, APK or embedded executable: it extracts the files, decompiles the GDScript and rebuilds the project directory, including imported resources converted back to their source formats. It supports projects made with Godot 2.x, 3.x and 4.x.

It also extracts and creates PCK archives, batch-decompiles and compiles GDScript bytecode, and converts resources between their text and binary forms. The same operations are available from the command line with --headless.
This is a community package: it installs the official Linux build from upstream's releases unmodified and follows new releases automatically.

This package grants access to your Downloads and Documents folders only; the rest of your home directory is not shared with the app. The app's own file dialog browses the sandbox, so it opens project archives from those folders and writes recovered projects beside them. To use a folder elsewhere, add it: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/games io.github.GDRETools.GDRE, or grant the whole home directory: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home io.github.GDRETools.GDRE. Undo it with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.GDRETools.GDRE. The app's default output location is the Desktop, which is not granted; choose a folder under Downloads or Documents with Select before extracting, or add flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-desktop io.github.GDRETools.GDRE.
Fixes encrypted projects not opening, C# assemblies loaded from a PCK, a crash when exporting animation_library resources, and log spam after scene export.
